title: 第十一章 神秘仙女星第十二章 狄氏七刀为白银盟主 飘荡墨尔本加更
content_zh:
“你不认识我？”沈梓语有些不敢相信的看着狄九，她绝不相信狄九不认识她。只是狄九为什么要用这种态度和她说话？
这女人果然就是沈梓语，狄九立即就反应过来，“我和你有什么关系那也是之前的事情，离婚之后早已是毫不相干，为什么要认识你？”
被一个陌生人莫名其妙闯进屋子，狄九心里本来就不舒服。虽说他对沈梓语并没有什么不好的印象，沈梓语毕竟甩了前世的他。在狄九看来，前世他和沈梓语离婚，绝对是被沈梓语甩了，现在他和沈梓语就是陌生人。
沈梓语平静的看着狄九，用没有波澜的语气说道，“也是，曾经你可以直接一脚把我踢开，自然也可以不认识我，是我赖着你了。仙女星即将彻底开放，短期内进入仙女星最简单的途径，是地球联盟国承认的大学武学系学生才可以。洛大开设武学院，这是一张入武学院的证明，如果你想去洛大学武，可以用这个证明去报名。”
说完沈梓语将一张蓝色的铜版纸放在满是灰尘的桌子上，转身就走。本来她还有一些话要和狄九说的，只是狄九这种态度，她再没有了要说什么的心思。
直到大门被带上的声音响起，狄九才反应过来。他和沈梓语离婚，似乎并不是沈梓语甩了他，而是他甩了沈梓语。
揉了揉额头，狄九感觉前世他似乎也不是一无是处。沈梓语这样的美女，他还不是说甩就甩了。
倒是仙女星彻底开放是什么意思？
无论仙女星彻底开放是怎么回事，又睡了一天的狄九都感觉到极度的饥饿。好在他现在的身体还不错，并没有头晕眼花的后遗症。
将家里简单收拾一下，又洗了一把澡，狄九这才出去找吃的。
走到洛津街头，狄九才明白什么是仙女星。这一刻，整个洛津市几乎每一个人都在议论两件事，第一仙女星将要开放了，第二洛大开设了武学。
一边听一边问，一餐饭吃完后，狄九彻底的弄清楚了这两件事对每一个人的意义。
仙女星是五年前出现的，几乎是在仙女星出现的同时，地球上绝大多数国家就得到了确切的消息。
实际上说起来仙女星算是太阳系的一颗行星，至于这颗行星是怎么来的，没有人知道。只知道五年前，太阳系的行星突兀多了一颗，这多出来的一颗行星就是仙女星。
最让人激动的不是太阳系突兀来了一颗行星，而是因为另外两点，其一仙女星是一颗生命星球，第二就是仙女星距离地球实在是太近了。想要从地球去仙女星，只要乘坐量子空天载人客机，飞行四十个小时就可以。
而量子空天飞机技术，仙女星没有来太阳系之前，就是华夏的成熟产品。可以穿越大气层，飞行速度更是超过了六十倍音速。
说仙女星是生命星球，并不是因为有科学家通过数据去对比过，而是因为就算是白痴踏上仙女星也知道这是生命星球。这里到处都是青翠绿植，到处都是各种稀奇古怪的强大野兽。
仙女星的星球面积无法估算，就是有很多科学家登上了仙女星，也无法获得更多的资料。
其中两点是到现在为止地球科学家也无法理解的，那就是进入仙女星只有一个入口通道。除去这个入口，从任何地方进入仙女星，都会被撕碎，无论是什么材料建造的飞机。还有就是这颗星球和地球相距如此近，和地球却没有半分影响。
不但如此，在仙女星中，也只有一小块空间可以飞行。除了这一小块空间，别的地方任何飞机包括了量子空天飞机，也是无法飞行的。这是数年来，无数科学家和探险家用鲜血和生命才找到的规律。

后来结合仙女星上寻找到的一些图形资料，华夏的一些玄学研究学家认为仙女星外面很有可能被一种神秘东西护住，让仙女星外表产生了搅碎任何接近事物的力量。这种护住仙女星的神秘东西让这颗星球虽然来到了太阳系旋转，却又独立于太阳系。这很有可能是一种护阵，尽管这听起来不可思议，事实上在华夏远的文化传承当中，曾经就出土过类似方面的资料。
为了探寻仙女星，死去了众多优秀的科学家和探险家，不过这对地球来说，都是值得的。这里有无数珍稀的植物，有些植物甚至只要一株，就可以让一个身患绝症的人康复。根据在仙女星常住的一些人描述，在仙女星居住，就是什么都不做，身体的小病小灾也会无缘无故消失。就凭这一点，仙女星就是比地球更适合人类生存的星球。
同样的，这里也有无数凶悍的野兽。那些死在仙女星上的人，大多是被凶猛的野兽吃掉。
随着地球的污染和破坏越来越严重，资源愈发的匮乏，这突兀出现的仙女星成了地球上每一个人的救星。为了仙女星，地球上所有的国家成立了一个地球联盟。这个联盟就是为了保护仙女星，所有进入仙女星的人都不允许用任何放射性的热武器。
初期进入仙女星的人，必须要是地球联盟承认的大学武学系学生。
仙女星开放后，全球每一所高校都想要开设武学系。事实开设武学系可没有这么简单，首先要向所在国家申请，然后报备地球联盟，只有地球联盟考察合格后，才可以开设武学系。
洛北大学在华夏算不上什么顶级大学，就是一流大学也够呛，因为洛北大学能开设武学，凭这一点就超过了国内许多的大学。
可以想象全国甚至全球有多少人会涌到洛大来，想要进入武学院学习。
直到这个时候，狄九才知道今天沈梓语给他的那个报名武学系的证明有多难得。
狄九摇了摇头，地球上的武学他是有记忆的，比起他所在的亚伦大陆来，那差的太远太远，更何况他身体原因还不能修武。
狄氏七刀修炼的第一步是手少阳关冲，他的手少阳关冲根本就无法感应到天地元气。
不能感应天地元气是不能练武的，若是强行练习，哪怕再多的滋补品也很快就会将身体练跨掉……
狄九刚刚想到这里，一丝淡弱的气息从手少阳三焦经关冲渗透进来，他忽地站起，那一丝气息消失的无影无踪。
狄九激动的忽地站起，盯着自己的左手无名指。他感应到元气了，居然感应到元气了。
从出生之后，他就无法修炼。在亚伦大陆那种地方，不能修炼就意味着是废物。如果可以，他宁可不要狄家的公子哥身份，也要修炼。甄蔓之所以放弃了他，就是因为他没有武根不能修炼。
如果不是当初对甄蔓爱到了骨子里，他根本就不会振作起来提出要去学医的。
没想到在他几乎要放弃练武的时候，他现在居然可以练武了。
（继续推荐最强弃少这本书！）
content_en:
"You don't know me?" Shen Ziyu looked at Di Jiu in disbelief. She never believed that Di Jiu didn't know her. But why did Di Jiu talk to her with this attitude?
As expected, this woman was Shen Ziyu. Di Jiu immediately reacted, "What relationship do I have with you happened before? After the divorce, we have nothing to do with each other. Why do we need to know you?"
Di Jiu felt uncomfortable when a stranger broke into the house for no apparent reason. Although he didn't have a bad impression of Shen Ziyu, Shen Ziyu had dumped him in his previous life. In Di Jiu's view, he divorced Shen Ziyu in his previous life and was definitely dumped by Shen Ziyu. Now he and Shen Ziyu are strangers.
Shen Ziyu looked at Di Jiu calmly and said in a calm tone, "That's right. Once upon a time, you could just kick me away, and naturally you didn't need to know me. I was relying on you. Fairy Star is about to be completely opened. The easiest way to enter Fairy Star in the short term is to be a martial arts student from a university recognized by the Earth Alliance. Luo University has opened a martial arts academy. This is a certificate to enter the martial arts academy. If you want to go to Luo University to martial arts, you can use this certificate to sign up."
After saying that, Shen Ziyu placed a piece of blue coated paper on the dusty table, turned around and left. Originally, she had something to say to Di Jiu, but with Di Jiu's attitude, she no longer had the intention to say anything.
Di Jiu didn't react until the sound of the door being closed was heard. He and Shen Ziyu divorced. It seemed that Shen Ziyu didn't dump him, but he dumped Shen Ziyu.
Rubbing his forehead, Di Jiu felt that he was not useless in his previous life. He dumped a beauty like Shen Ziyu without hesitation.
But what does it mean for Andromeda to be completely open?
No matter what happened to Fairy Star's complete opening, Di Jiu felt extremely hungry after sleeping for another day. Fortunately, he is in good health now and has no sequelae of dizziness.
After tidying up the house briefly and taking a shower, Di Jiu went out to find food.
Only when he walked to the streets of Luojin did Di Jiu understand what the Fairy Star was. At this moment, almost everyone in Luojin City was talking about two things. The first was that Fairy Star was about to open, and the second was that Luo University was opening a martial arts school.
Listening and asking questions at the same time, after finishing the meal, Di Jiu completely understood the meaning of these two things to everyone.
Andromeda appeared five years ago. Almost at the same time that Andromeda appeared, most countries on the earth received the exact news.
In fact, Andromeda is a planet in the solar system. As for how this planet came from, no one knows. I only know that five years ago, there was an extra planet in the solar system, and the extra planet was Andromeda.
The most exciting thing is not that a planet suddenly arrived in the solar system, but because of two other points. One is that Andromeda is a living planet, and the other is that Andromeda is too close to the earth. If you want to go from Earth to Andromeda, you only need to take a Quantum Space Manned Airliner and fly for forty hours.
As for quantum space plane technology, it was a mature product of China before Andromeda came to the solar system. It can travel through the atmosphere, and its flight speed exceeds sixty times the speed of sound.
It is said that Andromeda is a living planet, not because scientists have compared it through data, but because even an idiot who sets foot on Andromeda knows that it is a living planet. There are green plants everywhere and all kinds of strange and powerful beasts everywhere.
The planet area of ​​Andromeda cannot be estimated. Even if many scientists boarded Andromeda, they could not obtain more information.
Two of the points that Earth scientists have not been able to understand until now are that there is only one entryway into Andromeda. Except for this entrance, entering Andromeda from anywhere will be torn to pieces, no matter what material the aircraft is made of. What’s more, this planet is as far away from the earth asIt's so close, but it doesn't have any influence on the earth.
Not only that, but in Andromeda, there is only a small space to fly. Except for this small space, any aircraft, including the quantum space plane, cannot fly elsewhere. This is a rule that countless scientists and explorers have discovered over the years with their blood and lives.
Later, combined with some graphic data found on Andromeda, some Chinese metaphysical researchers believed that the outside of Andromeda was likely to be protected by a mysterious thing, which gave the surface of Andromeda the power to destroy anything that came close. This mysterious thing that protects Andromeda makes this planet independent of the solar system even though it rotates in the solar system. This is most likely a protective formation. Although this sounds incredible, in fact, similar information has been unearthed in Huaxiayuan's cultural heritage.
Many outstanding scientists and explorers died in order to explore Andromeda, but it was all worth it for the earth. There are countless rare plants here, and some plants can even make a terminally ill person recover with just one plant. According to the descriptions of some people who live on Andromeda, if you live on Andromeda and do nothing, your body's minor illnesses and disasters will disappear for no reason. Based on this alone, Andromeda is a planet more suitable for human survival than the Earth.
Likewise, there are countless ferocious beasts here. Most of those who died on Andromeda were eaten by ferocious beasts.
As the pollution and destruction of the earth become more and more serious, and resources become increasingly scarce, the sudden appearance of Andromeda has become the savior of everyone on the earth. For Andromeda, all the countries on Earth formed an Earth Alliance. This alliance is to protect Andromeda, and no one entering Andromeda is allowed to use any radioactive thermal weapons.
Those who enter Andromeda in the early stages must be martial arts students from universities recognized by the Earth Alliance.
After the opening of Fairy Star, every university in the world wants to open a martial arts department. In fact, opening a martial arts department is not that simple. You must first apply to the country where you are located, and then report to the Earth Alliance. Only after passing the Earth Alliance inspection can you open a martial arts department.
Luobei University is not considered a top university in China, even a first-class university is not enough, because Luobei University can offer martial arts, which surpasses many domestic universities.
You can imagine how many people from all over the country and even the world will flock to Luoyang University to study in the martial arts academy.
Until this moment, Di Jiu didn't know how rare the certificate Shen Ziyu gave him today for enrolling in the martial arts department.
Di Jiu shook his head. He had memories of martial arts on Earth. Compared with the Aaron Continent where he was, it was far, far behind. What's more, he couldn't practice martial arts due to physical reasons.
The first step in Di's Seven Swordsmanship training is Shaoyang Guanchong. His Shaoyang Guanchong cannot sense the vitality of heaven and earth at all.
You cannot practice martial arts if you cannot sense the vitality of heaven and earth. If you practice forcefully, no matter how many tonics you take, your body will soon become exhausted...
Just when Di Jiu thought of this, a faint breath penetrated from the Sanjiao meridian of Shaoyang in his hand. He suddenly stood up, and the breath disappeared without a trace.
Di Jiu suddenly stood up excitedly and stared at the ring finger of his left hand. He sensed vitality, actually sensed vitality.
He has been unable to practice since birth. In a place like Aaron's Continent, being unable to practice means being useless. If possible, he would rather not be the young master of the Di family and still practice cultivation. The reason why Zhen Man gave up on him was because he couldn't practice without martial arts roots.
If he hadn't fallen in love with Zhen Man to the core, he would never have cheered up and proposed to study medicine.
Unexpectedly, when he almost gave up practicing martial arts, he could actually practice martial arts now.
(Continue to recommend the book The Strongest Abandoned Young Master!)
